Effects apply to the Identity with the earliest Deployment order - Prioritizes The Index Identities Combat Start: If this unit's leftmost Skill on the Dashboard and other allies target the same enemy Slot, said Skill deals +5% damage for every ally targeting the same Slot excluding this unit (max 15%, applies when this unit and allies both use Base Attack Skills to main-target enemy Slot)

review: Index Faust is a Poise Sinking identity whose gimmick is to follow “Prescript” and in turn, follow a set gameplay pattern to ramp up “Grace of the Prescript” status and get stronger the longer the fight goes on. While it could have been done interestingly, in practice, it is mostly inconsequential on top of her Sinking, being an addition one should not focus on. Starting with her unique effects, which she has 5 that are automatically given or inflicted at turn start, from her 2 built-in passives. - “Prescript” status is what this ID is built around; essentially is a secondary objective with various requirements based on the amount of “Grace of the Prescript” status, ranging from hitting a marked enemy or using a marked skill to hitting with an E.G.O or marked Skill 3.
